about: Every quote change, quote withdrawal and trade the v12 bot saw in its logged live rounds against three figgie.com Hard bots at private tables (rounds lost when the app closed the page, or when figgie.com dropped a stalled page to its login screen, are not included). Same format as live_logs_v11.json. resale_seed is the learned-resale model exactly as the round started (ResaleLearner.round_start_model: replay_live and paper_bot restore it with seed); learner_at_bell is the model's size and calibration at the end of the round.
